title: Pointless flight tracking
body: This app provides near constant push notifications, usually about things I don’t care about - like a passenger needing anti nausea meds, or a flight holding over North Carolina. It also provides these notifications with very little context, some with lots of aviation jargon; “hold at MAIVE until bingo, at bingo divert to KIAD” (???) Also, clicking on these notifications has led me to multiple instances of “this flight is no longer operating, tracking ended” or similar. There’s no way I’d pay $12.99 a WEEK for this (ridiculous) or even the more palatable $69 a year - it’s mostly just junk info.

It doesn’t appear you can list all of your upcoming flights, and are limited to tracking one specific flight at a time on the homepage. When airports have ground delays or ground stops, the text box containing the full message is truncated and you cannot click to expand it. The weather at airports and other data is off - for instance it said current conditions at DAL are 78° with snow. The real-time security wait times is helpful. body: The graphics look great. And it’s the first app I’ve seen that can show the digital messages between aircraft. But it has some odd limitations. 1. something this price really should have a free trial period or mode 2. there is no way to snap the map to the current location, which seems an inexcusable omission 3. generally it’s not very clear what is a button and what is a decoration. It uses custom switch graphics that are hard to interpret. It’s overly modal: if you have a tracking pane for a flight open, you can see the button for options but it just vibrates at you if you try to tap it. 4. why is there a thumbnail for the aircraft photo but it’s not tappable? 5. the AI summaries are cute but inaccurate and tend to identify every aircraft as a private jet 6. appreciate the custom notifications but they spam you multiple times with notifications for the same flight

title: Really nice! I like where this is going.
body: Not a bad app! 👍🏽 For 3D mode, the terrain and aircraft designs just need to be optimized/stabilized for viewing (some dark spots on the aircraft). I like the beacon and strobe lighting feature, really nice. Further, being able to see an aircraft bank left or right, and deploy landing gears in real time on arrival is very cool! Airport designs look very nice too! and hopefully, you can and more updated liveries. That would be a plus! If there was a one-time payment option (like maybe $49 - $99) to have this app permanently, I would definitely go for it and buy it. I just don’t think I can do a monthly or/ yearly plan. Otherwise, I give it 4/5 stars. Keep it up team!

The whole thing is made with AI though- or it appears so, and some of it shows. Theres a lot of info blocked by toolbars and stuff, and a simple human review would make the app a lot easier to use. Some might like it, but I find it strange that you pay 60$ a year for an app that then puts its advertisement over your screenshots? Oh well.
